messages.subject: Deducer 0.5-0
parts:
Hi All,

Deducer 0.5-0 is up on CRAN now. It will propagate to all mirrors in
the next few days.

Plug-in package developers: Make sure your packages work with the new
version of Deducer, and on R 2.14. The new namespace requirements may
cause some issues.

Ian
